name: Nar

attributes.attribute: granted wealth to a high king of Ireland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nar, sometimes written Nair, is an Irish goddess. Her name carries the sense of modesty. In some accounts she granted great wealth to a high king of Ireland. Scholars weigh her as a possible form of Flaith, the goddess of sovereignty.

okr.objective: Nar is an obscure Irish goddess linked to modesty and wealth.
key_results: Nar is an Irish goddess of modesty.
